components.note: 宀 (roof) — a lone person under a roof: alone, few; also in 家 home, 安 peace.
刂 (knife, 立刀旁) — cutting, as in 别 separate, 刻 carve, 剪 cut.
咅 (pōu) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 部 bù, 陪 péi and 培 péi.
肉 (meat) — rotting meat, with the broad cover 广 over it; 肉 also appears as ⺼ in body parts like 脸 face.
付 (fù) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 府 fǔ and 附 fù.
火 (fire) — cooked to mush, then rotten; also in 烧 burn, 灯 lamp.
兰 (lán) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 栏 lán and 拦 lán.
氵 (water) — crossing a river; also in 河 river, 海 sea.
度 (dù) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 镀 dù.
氵 (water) — water leaking through; also in 河 river, 海 sea.
屚 (lòu) — rain (雨) under a roof (尸): a leaking roof. It gives the sound and also sounds out 陋 lòu.
疒 (illness) — marks wounds and ailments, as in 病 sick, 痛 pain; 疤 is a scar.
巴 (bā) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 吧 ba, 爸 bà and 芭 bā.
鱼 (fish) — water creatures, as in 鲨 shark, 鲜 fresh; 鳄 is the crocodile.
咢 (è) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 愕 è and 腭 è.
廾 (two hands) — hands lifting an offering: to present respectfully. 奉 also sounds out 捧 pěng and 俸 fèng.
月 (moon) — moonlight, clear and bright; also in 明 bright.
良 (liáng) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 浪 làng, 狼 láng and 郎 láng.
木 (wood) — a wooden stick; also in 树 tree, 林 forest.
昆 (kūn) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 混 hùn.
尸 (a house shape) — roofs and buildings, as in 屋 room, 层 floor; the traditional 層 had 曾 céng for the sound, dropped in simplification.
目 (eye) — opening the eyes; also in 看 look, 眼 eye.
争 (zhēng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 挣 zhèng and 筝 zhēng.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — meat and body parts, as in 脸 face, 肝 liver; 腥 is the smell of raw meat.
星 (xīng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 猩 xīng and 醒 xǐng.
龙 — a picture of a dragon, simplified from 龍. It also sounds out 聋 lóng, 笼 lóng and 拢 lǒng.
虫 (insect, creature) — small animals, as in 蛇 snake, 蚊 mosquito.
下 (xià) is only a loose sound clue for xiā.
土 (earth) — levelling the ground, hence even; also in 地 ground, 城 city.
匀 (yún) gives a close sound and the idea of even; it also sounds out 钧 jūn.
力 (strength) — making an effort; also in 努 strive, 动 move.
免 (miǎn) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 晚 wǎn and 娩 miǎn.
虫 (creature) — the ancients pictured the rainbow as a serpent in the sky; also in 蛇 snake.
工 (gōng) is a loose clue; 红 hóng shares it and sounds exactly like 虹.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — words, as in 说 say, 话 speech; 谐 is harmonious talk.
皆 (jiē) shares the rhyme -ie; only a loose sound clue.
木 (wood) — notices were posted on wooden boards; also in 树 tree, 桌 table.
旁 (páng) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 膀 bǎng and 磅 bàng.
赤 (red) — two reds blazing together: glowing and brilliant.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — words and talk, as in 说 say, 请 please.
上 (shàng) is only a stand-in with the same rhyme -ang; the traditional 讓 used 襄 xiāng, also in 嚷 rǎng and 壤 rǎng.
氵 (water) — a bay on the water; also in 河 river, 海 sea.
奥 (ào) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 懊 ào.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — a written record; also in 说 say, 话 speech.
普 (pǔ) gives the exact sound.
羊 (sheep) — mouth-watering mutton; with 次 (standing for drool) it is the usual picture of envy.
心 (heart, bottom form ⺗) — feelings; also in 想 think, 念 miss.
莫 (mò) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 墓 mù and 幕 mù.
欠 (open mouth, yawn) — breath and mouth actions, as in 歌 song, 吹 blow, 欢 happy.
曷 (hé) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 喝 hē and 渴 kě.
口 (mouth) — a cat's meow; also in 叫 shout, 喵 meow.
米 (mǐ) gives the same syllable with a different tone; it also sounds out 眯 mī.
艹 (grass) — plants; 茎 is a stem, as in 草 grass, 花 flower. The right part also sounds out 经 jīng and 径 jìng.
忄 (heart) — a fitting feeling; also in 快 happy, 情 feeling.
合 (hé) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 洽 qià, as in 洽谈.
扌 (hand) — stretching out by hand; also in 拉 pull, 推 push.
广 (guǎng, wide) gives a rough sound and the idea of broad; the traditional 擴 used 廣.
你 (nǐ, you) — the base word; adding 心 makes it the polite form.
心 (heart) — respect from the heart; also in 想 think, 爱 love.
钅 (metal, simplified 金) — a metal hammer; also in 钱 money, 铁 iron.
垂 (chuí) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 捶 chuí and 睡 shuì.
阝 (mound, 左耳旁 on the left) — hills, as in 院 courtyard, 阳 sunny side; 隆 is high and grand.
卜 (divination) — cracks read on heated bones; 口 below is asking. 占 also sounds out 站 zhàn and 粘 zhān.
风 (wind) — storms and air, as in 飘 float; 飓 is a hurricane.
具 (jù) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 俱 jù and 惧 jù.
刂 (knife, 立刀旁) — cutting and peeling, as in 别, 刻, 剪.
录 (lù) is only a loose clue; it also sounds out 绿 lǜ and 碌 lù.
兆 — the cracks on a heated oracle bone, read as omens. It also sounds out 桃 táo, 挑 tiāo, 跳 tiào and 逃 táo.
羽 (feather) — 翁 first meant the neck feathers of a bird; the old-man sense is later.
公 (gōng) is only a loose sound clue for wēng.
饣 (food, simplified 食) — eating and hunger, as in 饭 meal, 饿 hungry, 饱 full.
几 (jī) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 机 jī and 肌 jī.
饣 (food, simplified 食) — eating and hunger, as in 饭 meal, 饱 full.
我 (wǒ) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 俄 é, 蛾 é and 鹅 é.
贝 (shell, old money) — paying to buy back; also in 财 wealth, 买 buy.
卖 (mài) is a stand-in for an older sound; the same part appears in 读 dú and 续 xù.
氵 (water) — moisture; also in 河 river, 海 sea.
闰 (rùn) gives the exact sound.
扌 (hand) — pushing aside by hand; also in 推 push, 拉 pull.
发 (fā) is only a loose clue; it also sounds out 泼 pō.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — body and flesh, as in 肥 fat, 脸 face; 脂 is fat.
旨 (zhǐ) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 指 zhǐ.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — body and flesh, as in 肥 fat, 脸 face; 肪 is animal fat.
方 (fāng) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 房 fáng and 防 fáng.
刂 (knife) — cutting something in two, hence a second or secondary one.
畐 (fú) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 富 fù, 福 fú and 幅 fú.
巾 (cloth) — a hanging cloth, as in 布 cloth, 帽 hat; 帘 is a curtain.
王 (jade, 斜玉旁) — gems and precious stones, as in 球 ball, 珠 pearl; 珊 is coral.
册 (cè) is a loose clue; 删 shān shares it and sounds exactly like 珊.
